title: COSMIC Func Document
description: Functional-process design artifact migrated from cosmic-claude assets/schemas/func.json; metadata dropped (no manual-editing UX in docwright), desiredCfps added as the chain anchor copied from the upstream req artifact, funcDesc and per-process dataGroups restored from cosmic-claude for the solution-document format.

index.description: 1-based position of this function in the upstream plan functions array; must equal the upstream req artifact's index

desiredCfps.description: CFP budget copied from the upstream req artifact's desiredCfps; anchors the later tech-stage breakdown

reqNo.description: Requirement number copied verbatim from the upstream req artifact's reqNo (display context for the solution-document format)

reqTitle.description: Requirement title copied verbatim from the upstream req artifact's reqTitle (display context)

l1Name.description: Level 1 function name copied verbatim from the upstream req artifact's l1Name

l2Name.description: Level 2 function name copied verbatim from the upstream req artifact's l2Name; present only when the upstream declared it (moduleLevels >= 2)

l3Name.description: Level 3 function name copied verbatim from the upstream req artifact's l3Name; present only when the upstream declared it (moduleLevels = 3)

funcDesc.description: Functional description expanded from the upstream req artifact's funcDesc into a full solution-document paragraph; minimum content length enforced by rule func/func-desc-min-length

diagrams.description: Full mermaid diagram source strings (sequence diagrams of the functional processes)

processes.description: Functional processes of this function; names must be unique within the document

name.description: Unique business-level process name (business object + action; design/technical words are rejected by rules)

description.description: What this process does for the originating user

originator.description: Who triggers this process (must differ from receiver)

origination_event.description: The triggering event of this process

dataGroups.description: Major data groups this process works on (rendered as the 主要数据组 column of the solution document); refined per-subprocess at the tech stage
